decisions.reason: Repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024 puts this product clearly above likely aspiration levels, so a bakery with no visible distress has little reason to search for alternatives and is very likely to retain it.

This bread stayed on the website across 2023 and 2024 without negative signals, which suggests at least satisfactory performance in the firm's core bread line, though its lack of standout evidence makes it more droppable than the award-winning products if resources tighten.

As a close fit with the firm's established seasonal stollen business and still presented in 2024, this product likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and benefits from the firm's ability to carry a coherent holiday assortment, even without explicit award evidence.
